# flux-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for Flux (sources, kustomizations, Helm releases, notifications, image automation, artifact generators).

CRDs are copied verbatim from [fluxcd/flux2](https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2)
at tag [`v2.10.0`](https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/tree/v2.10.0) (commit `3fa784edd773d56630bb9f62645e08f70c2cff0a`),
path(s) `manifests/crds`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install flux oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/flux-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.25.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install flux oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/flux-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd alerts.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io artifactgenerators.source.extensions.fluxcd.io buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io externalartifacts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io gitrepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io helmreleases.helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io helmrepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io kustomizations.kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io ocirepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io providers.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io receivers.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd alerts.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io artifactgenerators.source.extensions.fluxcd.io buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io externalartifacts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io gitrepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io helmreleases.helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io helmrepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io imageupdateautomations.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io kustomizations.kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io ocirepositories.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io providers.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io receivers.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```

## Values

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| `annotations` | object | `{}` | Extra annotations added to every CRD. |
| `labels` | object | `{}` | Extra labels added to every CRD. |
| `keepOnUninstall` | bool | `true` | Add `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep` so CRDs (and all their custom resources) survive `helm uninstall`. |

Unknown keys are rejected (`values.schema.json`).
